fields.Name: Skip ICF - Hierarchical Revenue Treemap
fields.Description: Treemap of 2025 confirmed revenue by category -> product, coloured by growth vs 2024, drilling to top buyers and their order lines. Ported from "Hierarchical Treemap with Color-Coded Drill-Down".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Create a treemap of our 2025 confirmed revenue by product category and product. Size each rectangle by revenue and colour it by growth versus 2024 (red for decline, green for growth). When I click a product, show a horizontal bar chart of the top 10 buyers of that product by spend. When I click a buyer, show a table of all their order lines with dates, products and amounts, and make each row open the order. Include a breadcrumb or back button. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a treemap sized by 2025 revenue with category and product levels
Colour encodes growth vs 2024 on a red-to-green scale, with a legend
Rectangles are labelled with product/category name and revenue
Clicking a product shows a horizontal bar chart of its top 10 buyers
Clicking a buyer shows their order lines with dates, products and amounts
Rows can open the underlying order record
Breadcrumb or back navigation is provided
